text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Ramonu... I hope this<n>will be a
joyful and successful year<n>for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh my, it's an honor to hear from you.<n>But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I must say, your well-wishes are<n>usually more...
verbose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Every year, I struggle with what to<n>say on your
birthday. I fear I have<n>been hiding those feelings
and many<n>more behind flowery words.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So this year, I chose to express<n>myself plainly and
honestly... Was it<n>insufficient?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...This reminds me of when you were<n>younger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...A crescent moon bearing a crown of<n>flowers, her
innocent radiance<n>glowing softly within.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...But even so, her faint glow could<n>never light up
the hidden depths of<n>the mountain that towered in
the night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Nor is it her responsibility to do so.<n>Does the moon
know this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She knows this now. That's why the<n>moon chose
to descend—to become<n>one with the earth and
support the<n>mountain as well as everything it<n>towers
over.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is why I offer my wishes to you<n>now, under
the brilliant light of the<n>sun... Happy birthday,
Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I see that no matter how<n>much you try to
hold it in, the core of<n>you never changes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Rudolf. I'm grateful to<n>receive your kind
words.
